description: List / search cloud-synced Meeting Bots meetings, newest first, like the Meetings page filters + search. Team-wide meetings only (visibility: all team members). Filters: from / to (YYYY-MM-DD, ISO datetime, or epoch millis; inclusive), labels, participantKeys (user id or email), participantDomains, searchText (full-text over title + transcript; hits include a searchSnippet with matches wrapped in ⟦ ⟧). Returns meetingId, title, startMillis, labels, participants, summaryStatus; page with nextPageToken. Use list-meeting-filter-options for exact label / domain / participant values, then get-meeting-transcript (summaryOnly first) per hit.
name: list-meetings
